title: Packaging — DPP characteristics
description: Field specifications for the Packaging Digital Product Passport, shaped for UNTP's credentialSubject.characteristics extension point. Economic operators and facility identifiers are carried by the UNTP envelope and are deliberately absent here.

gtin.title: GTIN
gtin.description: Global Trade Item Number assigned to the packaging unit.

packagingType.title: Packaging Type
packagingType.description: Classification of packaging by function: sales, grouped, transport, e-commerce, or reusable.

packagingFormat.title: Packaging Format
packagingFormat.description: Physical form of the packaging (bottle, box, bag, pouch, can, carton, tray, blister, wrapper, etc.).

packagingWeight.title: Packaging Weight
packagingWeight.description: Total weight of the empty packaging in grams.

packagingVolume.title: Packaging Volume
packagingVolume.description: Total volume capacity of the packaging in millilitres.

isReusable.title: Is Reusable
isReusable.description: Whether the packaging is designed and intended for reuse.

isSingleUse.title: Is Single Use
isSingleUse.description: Whether the packaging is intended for single use only.

materialType.title: Material Type
materialType.description: Primary material of the packaging component.

materialCode.title: Material Code
materialCode.description: Harmonized material identification code per Commission implementing act.

weightPercent.title: Weight Percent
weightPercent.description: Percentage by weight of this material component relative to total packaging weight.

componentName.title: Component Name
componentName.description: Name of the packaging component (e.g. cap, body, label, sleeve).

isContactSensitive.title: Is Contact Sensitive
isContactSensitive.description: Whether this material component is in direct contact with sensitive products (e.g. food, pharma).

totalMaterialCount.title: Total Material Count
totalMaterialCount.description: Total number of distinct material types used in the packaging.

isMultiMaterial.title: Is Multi-Material
isMultiMaterial.description: Whether the packaging consists of more than one material type.

materialPictogramCode.title: Material Pictogram Code
materialPictogramCode.description: Harmonized pictogram code for material identification, mandatory from August 2028.

performanceGrade.title: Recyclability Performance Grade
performanceGrade.description: Recyclability grade from A (>=95%) to E. Grades D/E not marketable from 2030; C phased out by 2038.

recyclablePercent.title: Recyclable Percent
recyclablePercent.description: Percentage of the packaging that is recyclable by weight.

designForRecyclingCompliant.title: Design for Recycling Compliant
designForRecyclingCompliant.description: Whether the packaging meets design-for-recycling criteria per delegated acts.

assessmentStandard.title: Assessment Standard
assessmentStandard.description: Standard or methodology used for recyclability assessment.

atScaleRecycling.title: At-Scale Recycling
atScaleRecycling.description: Whether the packaging is recycled at scale (required from 2035).

sortingEfficiency.title: Sorting Efficiency
sortingEfficiency.description: Percentage efficiency of sorting the packaging in waste management infrastructure.

recyclateQuality.title: Recyclate Quality
recyclateQuality.description: Quality assessment of the recyclate output from this packaging.

recycledContentMaterialType.title: Recycled Content Material Type
recycledContentMaterialType.description: Material type for which recycled content is declared.

recycledPercent.title: Recycled Content Percent
recycledPercent.description: Total percentage of recycled content in the material by weight.

postConsumerPercent.title: Post-Consumer Recycled Percent
postConsumerPercent.description: Percentage of post-consumer recycled content in the material.

certificationScheme.title: Certification Scheme
certificationScheme.description: Third-party certification scheme verifying recycled content claims.

massBalanceApplied.title: Mass Balance Applied
massBalanceApplied.description: Whether mass balance accounting was used for recycled content calculation.

sortingComponentName.title: Sorting Component Name
sortingComponentName.description: Name of the packaging component for sorting/disposal instructions.

binDestination.title: Bin Destination
binDestination.description: Which waste bin or stream this component should be disposed in.

pictogramUrl.title: Sorting Pictogram URL
pictogramUrl.description: URL to the harmonized sorting/disposal pictogram image for this component.

consumerInstruction.title: Consumer Instruction
consumerInstruction.description: Instructions for the consumer on how to sort/dispose of this component.

localizedLanguage.title: Localized Language
localizedLanguage.description: Language code for the localized sorting/disposal instructions.

depositReturnSystemApplicable.title: Deposit Return System Applicable
depositReturnSystemApplicable.description: Whether this packaging is subject to a deposit-return scheme (DRS).

depositReturnSystemId.title: Deposit Return System ID
depositReturnSystemId.description: Identifier of the deposit-return system this packaging is registered with.

minRotations.title: Minimum Rotations
minRotations.description: Minimum number of reuse rotations/trips the packaging is designed for.

reuseSystemName.title: Reuse System Name
reuseSystemName.description: Name of the reuse system or scheme the packaging participates in.

collectionPointsUrl.title: Collection Points URL
collectionPointsUrl.description: URL to a page listing collection/return points for reusable packaging.

reuseInstructions.title: Reuse Instructions
reuseInstructions.description: Instructions for the consumer on how to return or reuse the packaging.

substanceName.title: Substance Name
substanceName.description: Name of the substance of concern present in the packaging.

casNumber.title: CAS Number
casNumber.description: Chemical Abstracts Service registry number for the substance.

concentrationPpm.title: Concentration (ppm)
concentrationPpm.description: Concentration of the substance in the packaging material in parts per million.

pfasPresent.title: PFAS Present
pfasPresent.description: Whether per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) are present in the packaging.

heavyMetalsSumPpm.title: Heavy Metals Sum (ppm)
heavyMetalsSumPpm.description: Sum of lead, cadmium, mercury and hexavalent chromium concentrations. Must be <= 100 ppm.

heavyMetalsMaxPpm.title: Heavy Metals Maximum Allowed (ppm)
heavyMetalsMaxPpm.description: Regulatory maximum for the sum of Pb + Cd + Hg + Cr(VI). Currently 100 ppm.

labelHarmonized.title: Harmonized Label Applied
labelHarmonized.description: Whether the packaging bears the EU harmonized labelling per PPWR Art. 12.

materialCompositionPictogram.title: Material Composition Pictogram
materialCompositionPictogram.description: URL or reference to the material composition pictogram on the packaging.

bioBasedContentPercent.title: Bio-Based Content Percent
bioBasedContentPercent.description: Voluntary declaration of bio-based content percentage in the packaging material.

compostabilityCertified.title: Compostability Certified
compostabilityCertified.description: Whether the packaging has been certified as compostable.

compostabilityStandard.title: Compostability Standard
compostabilityStandard.description: Standard under which compostability was certified (e.g. EN 13432).

declarationId.title: Declaration of Conformity ID
declarationId.description: Unique identifier of the EU declaration of conformity for this packaging.

issuerName.title: Issuer Name
issuerName.description: Name of the entity that issued the declaration of conformity.

issueDate.title: Issue Date
issueDate.description: Date when the declaration of conformity was issued.

conformsToArticles.title: Conforms to Articles
conformsToArticles.description: List of PPWR articles/provisions the packaging conforms to.

documentUrl.title: Declaration Document URL
documentUrl.description: URL to the full declaration of conformity document.

dataCarrierType.title: Data Carrier Type
dataCarrierType.description: Type of data carrier on the packaging (QR code per PPWR).

dataCarrierUri.title: Data Carrier URI
dataCarrierUri.description: GS1 Digital Link URI encoded in the data carrier.

dataCarrierFormat.title: Data Carrier Format
dataCarrierFormat.description: Technical format specification of the data carrier.

dataCarrierEncoding.title: Data Carrier Encoding
dataCarrierEncoding.description: Character encoding used in the data carrier.

retentionPeriodYears.title: Data Retention Period (Years)
retentionPeriodYears.description: Number of years the DPP data must be retained. 5 for single-use, 10 for reusable packaging.

accessTier.title: Access Tier
accessTier.description: Default data access tier for the data carrier content.

emptySpacePercent.title: Empty Space Percent
emptySpacePercent.description: Percentage of empty space in the packaging relative to total volume.

maxAllowedEmptySpacePercent.title: Maximum Allowed Empty Space Percent
maxAllowedEmptySpacePercent.description: Maximum allowed empty space percentage. 40% for e-commerce packaging per PPWR Art. 10.

weightOptimised.title: Weight Optimised
weightOptimised.description: Whether the packaging weight has been optimised to the minimum necessary for safety and hygiene.
